body.message:
Price we have shared with you is the best and final rate we can offer. Unfortunately, we are unable to reduce the price any further.

As per your request, please find below the rates for Cloud Tower – 1 Bedroom Apartment:

Stay Period: 10th October to 28th November
Total Duration: 49 nights
Total Rate: AED 9,500

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The refundable damage deposit will be processed within 7 working days after check-out and will be refunded to the same card used for the original payment.

Thank you.
